experiments.scope: One fixed 128-byte two-block message pair on the exact sha256-r31-prefix-v1 target: the first collision (trial index 2,685,579,961) of the single fresh-seed r31k K-scan charged in proof.md Section 3. Every organizer trial seed returns the same pair via sha256(DOMAIN + seed + trial_le4); the organizer recomputes both reduced-round digests. All trials are returned; nothing is skipped.
experiments.hypothesis: Every pair the program can return is a pair of distinct 128-byte messages with equal 31-step SHA-256 digests under the organizer verifier. This evidences the collision RELATION of the replayed construction only; the attack cost is charged in proof.md and no success frequency or cost is inferred from this experiment.
